processLesson.lesson: Adapter memory lifetime, not request size alone, controls safe job shape. Exact one-taxon process isolation converted a nonrecoverable five-taxon failure into six predictable complete runs.
applied: Split the failed multi-taxon scope into one taxon per process.
Reused all six verified taxonomy identities and prevented six provider requests.
Kept live provider concurrency at one while MAIN integration and shared generation remained sequential.
Reported six protocol closures separately from zero applicability, denominator, present, absence, not-detected, and certification-blocker movement.
Retained the excluded non-binomial cell for taxonomy review rather than repeating a provider call.
processLesson.nextRoundChange: Use the repository lease builder instead of hand-shaped lease JSON, and keep the next cached cohort one taxon per process until the adapter is redesigned for streaming or bounded per-taxon memory.

nextRankedSourcePortfolio.reason: This multi-jurisdiction cohort has the strongest verified next net movement per expected occurrence request with reusable taxonomy identities and no unresolved structural failure.
One Montana non-binomial cell and seven USGS NAS partial cells need exact record review. Replaying the same provider or archive cannot establish completeness.
Alabama has the largest strategic scope and active certification impact, but 837 uncached taxa require a provider-native GBIF bulk design and separate authoritative applicability work.
These scopes remain useful but have lower expected movement per provider call or weaker verified cache coverage than the four-state cached cohort.

automatedNationalAcquisition.qualification: This is summed worker-process time for six zero-candidate one-page calls. It excludes preflight, queue gaps, MAIN integration, generation, provider variation, and release overhead, so it is not an end-to-end completion forecast.

stateSpecificResearch.qualification: Authority, geography, taxonomy, pagination, and review burden remain source-specific and cannot be extrapolated from these GBIF screens.

applicabilityReview.qualification: Round 56 performed no applicability review and measured no applicability throughput.

blockedExceptions.qualification: These require exact source, taxonomy, or geography resolution and cannot be inferred from source silence.

The private Vercel deployment ID and runtime-log query remain unavailable.
